purpose: Alternative HA8 solid-shell metal plate: preserve physical volume/material/mass, translations only. DKT w0 angular checks pass but zero-P absolute gate and bending native work balance fail; preserve those failures.

plate.formulation: TYPE1 Ish3n31 DKT_S3; same LAW2 card, triangular mesh, no rotational initial conditions

motion.bending_displacement: z=k*x²/2; x-displacement=-k²*x³/6 eliminates leading membrane stretch; all nodes prescribed. Interior elements with full neighbor stencil compared to Kirchhoff bending, boundary response kept separately.

constraints: No body/sandwich/whole input changed. LAW25 composite and core coupling require separate declared witnesses. Prototype curvature does not target observed damage. Refinement changes lumped masses at nodes, preserving volume and density; record discrete and continuum inertia separately.

changes.property: TYPE20 HA8 Isolid14 Ismstr4 Icstr010 Inpts222, standard thickness bottom-to-top s direction per official documentation. No independently rotating nodes. Native readback and geometry record required.
changes.mesh: NxNx1 through thickness, matched50mm3 at N6/N12. Lumped nodal masses integrate all hexa volumes, physical continuum tensor is separate. One thickness layer; no exact continuum inertia claim.
changes.material: identical LAW2 metal card. No LAW25/composite conversion.
changes.reference: 3D uniaxial affine elastic field, then plane-stress cylindrical bending with through-thickness displacement. E/nu/thickness preserved; independent analytic energy, all volume compared.
changes.bending: ux=-k*x*z-k²*x³/6; uy=0; uz=k*x²/2+nu/(1-nu)*k*z²/2. Plane stress sigma_z=0 to first order, curvature_y=0.
